0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9) host the Miami Heat (4-6) in Utah's 11th game of the season, with the Jazz on an eight-game losing streak, 1-4 at home and 0-5 on the road, while Miami has won its last game and sits 2nd in the Southeast, 2 games back. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Keyonte George (ankle sprain), all listed as out, and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist sprain) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Jazz winning the last meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026, and they have not played each other yet this season.
